why: the river's bare-water join never writes a tile paintPath has not already written and marked: paintPath runs first inside paintPathWithSubPathJoins and its corner and elbow arms cover every tile water() then overwrites. Verified by applying this mutant and fuzzing 4,000 random road/track/river/stream/corner/rect/ground combinations - the mask disagreed with the writes in ZERO of them. The mark is kept as belt-and-braces: it costs nothing and it does not depend on paintPath's arms staying exactly as they are.
